question: Long-range combat versus the screen. At 32 px/m on a 1422x800 window, the view reaches about 22 m left and right of Rivet and about 12.5 m up and down. The 35 m range lane is off screen, and above or below Rivet even 15 m is off screen. How should twin-stick long range work?

options.label: Camera leads toward the mouse (aim look-ahead, up to about 10 m)
options.tradeoff: 35 m targets reach the edge of the screen when aimed at; the camera moves while Rivet stands still

options.label: Cap readable long range at about 20 m; the 35 m lane only tests off-screen fire
options.tradeoff: a calm, fixed camera; 'long range' becomes about 20 m

options.label: Zoom out to about 24 px/m while aiming or holding a weapon
options.tradeoff: sees everything, but Rivet and bullets get smaller
